cfaef5a656ddbd18.description:
About The Team

At Zillow Group, we are constantly innovating ways to operate, monetize, and improve our nationwide real estate marketplace. The Data Science, Analytics and Engineering team supports several lines of business across the company by partnering closely with business leaders and engineering to model, analyze, and surface business relevant metrics that inform both short- and long-term decision-making. Our structure is very flat and you will soon find yourself interacting directly across a wide variety of roles.

Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes. Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.

About The Role

As an Analytics Engineer, you'll build and own the data models and metric definitions that stakeholders across Zillow depend on for consumer analytics, including marketing, lead generation, and site traffic. You’ll work with your team and your stakeholders within business domains to create and manage the metrics that drive day-to-day operations and strategic priorities. You'll write transformation code, implement performant metrics as trusted data products, build data-quality tests, and document your work so people and increasingly, AI systems can trust and build on top of the foundation you lay.

You Will Get To

• Build and maintain dimensional data models and metric definitions using SQL and dbt (or equivalent)
• Design data-quality tests, monitoring, and alerting so your data products are trusted by default
• Partner with data engineering to define upstream requirements and fix data-quality issues at the source
• Work directly with US-based BI analysts, data scientists, and stakeholders to understand what they actually need, not just what they wrote down
• Contribute to semantic layer definitions that make metrics usable by BI tools, data scientists, and AI systems alike

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.

Who you are

• 2+ years of professional data experience, with metrics-as-code and semantic modelling preferred
• Strong SQL, with understanding of how grain, joins, and schema evolution affect relational modeling and metric implementation
• Experience with dbt or an equivalent transformation framework, plus Git and CI/CD basics
• Comfort operating across a large time-zone gap; proactive asynchronous communication
• A track record of evolving how AI systems, conversational analytics tools, and machine learning workflows consume structured data
• Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, or similar) and BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar)
• Zillow values the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds — we encourage you to apply if you have transferable skills

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact your recruiter directly.

Qualified applicants will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law.

With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:
Camunda Hub is where enterprises run Camunda at scale. From Hub they manage their clusters and tenants, decide who can do what, and roll changes out across the whole organization. We’re looking for a Senior Product Builder to own the backend and architecture that let Hub manage a whole fleet of clusters. Your first focus will be the mechanism that sends access, secret, tenant and licence changes out to every connected cluster and brings deployments, health and audit records back. From there, you’ll shape Hub’s foundations: its event model, the service boundaries and data model other teams build on, and how Hub behaves when things fail or get upgraded. The platform is your product. Your users are platform administrators, Centres of Excellence and the builders across Camunda who depend on what you create. You’ll join a new two-person pod in our remote-first team. You’ll have real ownership as the person who makes the call, and you’ll build AI-first, from written specs through to production. Our customers run mission-critical processes on Camunda, so your work will matter to them every day.
What You Will Do:
• 
Take over Hub's fleet propagation mechanism from the team building its first version, and make it work for access, secrets, tenants, licences and custom roles
• 
Write short design documents for foundational changes, get them reviewed by the teams that depend on them, and turn them into tested, shipped code
• 
Design how Hub behaves when things go wrong: offline clusters, partial failures, Hub outages, and clusters being adopted or detached
• 
Build the path from clusters back to Hub, starting with deployment inventory, health, audit records and licence status
• 
Design Hub's first event and webhook mechanism, so admins and agents can react to changes instead of polling for them
• 
Join the pod's rotations and Hub on-call, and help other builders take on backend work through reviews, guidelines and contract tests
What You Will Bring to the Role:
• 
Experience building and running backend systems in production that other teams or customers depend on
• 
Comfort taking a problem nobody owns yet and turning it into a design, a plan and shipped code
• 
Product judgment for technical users: you talk to the people who use your APIs and make trade-offs on their behalf
• 
Clear, short writing that lets a remote team review and decide asynchronously
• 
Care for how a system behaves when parts of it fail, not only for the happy path
Must Haves:
• 
Designed and shipped a control plane or similar system that pushes desired state to many targets. Knows outbox or event-log patterns, idempotent apply, versioning, retries and drift reconciliation
• 
Senior backend engineering in Java (API design, relational data models, multi-tenant SaaS services) and hands-on Helm and Kubernetes for self-managed installations
• 
Software architecture and failure analysis: partial failure, blast radius, consistency trade-offs. Has debugged production incidents in a distributed system and is ready for on-call
• 
Has shaped an API or platform as a product, and writes design docs other teams can build on. Gets agreement across teams without formal authority
• 
Builds AI-first from written specifications and checks AI output as carefully as any other code
Nice to Haves:
• 
Kubernetes operators or GitOps tools, for example Argo CD
• 
OIDC, SCIM and permission models, or secret managers and licence systems
• 
Camunda 8 or another workflow or orchestration engine
• 
Enough frontend skill to build a thin UI on top of a backend capability

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
